links.outcome: Engagement with AI chat by insurance, socioeconomic vulnerability, age, race
links.effect: Decreasing engagement associated with older patient age (OR 0.96 [0.93-0.99]), higher SVI socioeconomic score (0.28 [0.16-0.49]), and Medicaid insurance (0.68 [0.52-0.88]); higher SVI housing & transportation score increased engagement (2.08 [1.26-3.43]).
links.quote: Lower chat engagement was observed among non-White patients and those with lower socioeconomic status.

screen.reason: Evaluated patient engagement disparities with a deployed post-appendectomy AI-based chat intervention across different social determinants of health.
